metadataRaw.description:
https://www.bestspinecare.com 

In this quick video, Dr. Rowe goes over sleeping positions that may help lessen sciatica pain while sleeping. Also, he demonstrates a better way of getting out of bed in the morning so you don't have a sciatic nerve pain flare-up.  

If you're suffering from shooting sciatic nerve pain into the thigh, leg, calf, foot, or toes... this is a MUST watch. Also, check out our other videos that give more info on sciatica pain, and how to relieve it.
